decisions.rationale: Ossifying Fibroma does not match the clinical presentation and histopathological findings
Giant cell tumor of bone is a different entity with distinct clinical and histological features
Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG) is a rare entity with different clinical and histological features
